assumptions.rationale: Values are illustrative only. They model a quality-screening scenario where correctly identifying good wines has higher value, while false premium routing and missed good wines both carry practical cost.
assumptions.unit: relative decision-value points per held-out wine sample

limitations: The values are simulated and are not real business figures.
A real deployment would need domain-calibrated costs, intervention capacity, and risk review.
The analysis uses a held-out public dataset split rather than production outcomes.
practical_value: Positive simulated value indicates that the model could support prioritised quality review under the stated assumptions.
use_case: Demonstration of how a winery or quality-control team could triage samples for premium review using model predictions.
